name: site-power-settlement
description: 施工现场临时用电申请与电表结算系统（NestJS + React + Prisma + SQLite）

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: npm run db:setup && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run start:dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
